prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 2 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1317; do not mention it.)
text:
Clinical Treatment Summary

Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was sideswiped while changing lanes. The patient reports immediate onset of neck pain and low back pain with associated muscle stiffness and reduced range of motion. No loss of consciousness was reported. No head strike was reported.

On examination, cervical and lumbar paraspinal muscles were tender to palpation with palpable muscle guarding. Cervical range of motion was reduced in rotation and extension. Lumbar flexion was limited. Neurological examination showed intact motor strength, sensation, and reflexes in the upper and lower extremities. No signs of radiculopathy were observed.

Diagnosis: cervical strain and lumbar strain following motor vehicle collision.

Treatment consisted of soft tissue therapy, gentle range-of-motion exercises, and a home stretching program. Over-the-counter anti-inflammatory medication was recommended for pain control. The patient was advised to apply heat to affected areas and to avoid heavy lifting during the acute phase.

At the second visit, the patient reported partial improvement in neck and back symptoms. Range of motion had improved, and tenderness was reduced. The patient was encouraged to continue the home exercise program and to return if symptoms worsened or failed to improve. Prognosis is considered good with continued conservative care.
